title: Director of Business Systems Product Management
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.

Verkada runs on four value streams - Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them.

The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Others face employees, where the experience drives how the company scales. The bar is the same on both sides: systems people choose to use, intuitive enough to need almost no training, and scalable so overall company growth exceeds the rate of headcount growth. 

Your team is organized by the functions it serves: Partner Ecosystem (Partner Portal and vStore), Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Legal, and People. Each product manager owns the systems roadmap for their function and acts as the product counterpart to that function's leadership. You own the whole - including the parts that only work when someone connects them. A partner order has to land cleanly in NetSuite. A headcount plan has to reconcile between Workday and the financial model.

This is a fully onsite role in our San Mateo HQ

What You'll Do

• Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.

• Recruit and coach 6-10 PMs to write strong requirements, manage roadmaps, and serve as strategic partners to business leaders.

• Drive product strategy, architecture, and roadmap for all enterprise business systems to support scalable, public-company growth. Lead a team of 6-10 PMs and analysts across key operational domains.

• Define the systems roadmap, lead make-vs-buy decisions, manage total cost of ownership (TCO), and establish a standardized intake process for all business requests.

• Partner Ecosystem & vStore: Build and scale self-service portal for quoting, deal registration, order management, and billing.

• Finance: Oversee NetSuite order-to-cash and financial close systems.

• Supply Chain: Manage inventory, order processing, logistics, and contract manufacturer integrations.

• Legal & People: Automate employee lifecycle systems and identity/access provisioning.

• Build SOX-ready controls, auditability, and data warehouse integrations to public-company standards.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Finance, Business, or another technical/analytical field.

title: Independent Contractor Salesforce Integration Specialist (Remote Americas)
description:
Forbes Travel Guide is seeking a detail-oriented Integration Specialist to support our Salesforce ecosystem by managing and optimizing integrations between Salesforce and external platforms. This role focuses on building, configuring, testing and maintaining Salesforce-connected forms and digital experience workflows that support partner engagement and operational processes across the organization.
The ideal candidate has strong experience working with Salesforce-integrated forms and digital experience platforms such as Titan Web, understands Salesforce data structures and declarative configuration, and is comfortable managing integrations that involve APIs, webhooks and middleware such as Workato.
This role is not a developer position and does not require Apex coding. Instead, the Integration Specialist will leverage Salesforce declarative tools and integration platforms to ensure reliable data flow, form functionality, and system connectivity across the FTG technology ecosystem.
FTG is the global authority on hospitality excellence. Known for our prestigious annual Star Ratings awarded to hotels, restaurants, spas, and cruise ships in more than 100 countries, we also provide professional services such as training, custom standards, inspections, verification programs and consulting for luxury hospitality and other businesses that prioritize guest/customer experience.
Key Responsibilities

• Build, configure, and maintain Salesforce-integrated forms and workflows, including platforms such as Titan, to support lead capture, operational processes, and partner interactions

• Manage and test integrations between Salesforce and external platforms, ensuring accurate data flow and reliable system connectivity

• Configure and maintain webhooks, middleware integrations, and automation workflows using platforms such as Workato

• Support the implementation and optimization of digital experience platforms connected to Salesforce, ensuring seamless user experiences and clean data capture

• Maintain Salesforce data hygiene by monitoring incoming data from forms and integrations, identifying duplicates or inconsistencies, and supporting processes that ensure accurate and reliable CRM data

• Perform integration testing, troubleshooting and QA to validate form submissions, API connections, and downstream automation

• Collaborate with marketing, operations, and technology teams to ensure integrations align with business requirements

• Monitor integration performance, identify issues proactively, and implement improvements to enhance system reliability

• Maintain documentation for integrations, workflows, and system dependencies to support operational continuity

Qualifications

• Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator certification (Required)

• 3+ years of experience working within the Salesforce ecosystem

• Demonstrated experience implementing and managing Salesforce-integrated forms platforms (Titan experience strongly preferred)

• Experience working with webhooks, APIs, and middleware platforms such as Workato or similar integration tools

• Strong understanding of Salesforce CRM data structures, objects, and Flow Builder

• Proven ability to troubleshoot integration issues and perform structured testing across connected systems

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills; ability to work independently and efficiently in a remote team environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II and/or Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder certifications

• Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or marketing automation workflows

• Experience supporting lead capture workflows or marketing technology stacks integrated with Salesforce

• Experience documenting system architecture or integration workflows

title: Sales Development Representative (HR Advisory) - Atlanta, GA
description:

Headquartered in NC and Atlanta, Georgia, respectively. The next 24 months are about building and expanding a real book across the HR Advisory practice serving behavioral health and HHS clients.

TWF's HR Advisory division has product-market fit and a founding-cohort partnership pipeline. The closing motion has been founder-led until now. You're the first SDR. You'll build the outbound motion that refills the pipeline at the cadence the division needs to hit $1.2M Y1 ARR. If you're the right person, you become a partner in this division long-term.
The partner upside

• TWF Earned Equity Ladder: Tier 2 (1-3% equity) eligible at month 6 against the 5-gate evaluation

• Tier 4 (8-15% equity, true partner level) by month 36 for the right person

title: R&D Technician
Product Designer - Planter Boxes
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY
Our client is an Australian laser cutting and sheet metal fabrication business supplying a wide range of businesses nationally. One division of the company designs and manufactures architectural planter boxes, also supplied nationally to construction companies. The division has grown steadily over recent years and is now expanding, and currently includes an estimator and a designer.
ABOUT THE ROLE
This role owns the whole path of a planter box job, from reading the architect's, landscape or structural drawings and completing the take-off, to drafting and structurally assessing the planter box against the project's specific dimensions and quoting the job, and (on won jobs) producing the drawings the customer approves and the cut-ready files the factory works from.
This is a structural drafting and stress-analysis-led role, with estimating as the lighter component. The planter box's overall design has already been established by the company, so the core skill isn't ground-up product design, it's working out the stiffener count and placement for each job's specific dimensions, and carrying out the structural/stress analysis (particularly where planter boxes are used as balustrades on high-rise developments) to confirm the structure won't tip or fail under load. Quoting runs on the company's own standard estimating formulas, so take-off accuracy and this structural judgement matter far more than estimating technique.
The role is dedicated to this company and works as part of its existing team (which already includes an estimator and a designer), rather than being shared across multiple clients.
During quieter periods (for example the construction industry's December-January shutdown), the candidate may be asked to support other departments, such as general estimation or laser-machine programming, to keep them productively engaged.
PRIMARY PURPOSE
To independently take a planter box job from an architect's or construction drawing through take-off, structural drafting and quoting, and (once a job is won) through to customer approval drawings and factory-ready cut files, applying sound structural judgement and commercial scope awareness throughout.

title: Product Analyst
description:
About Dynamo AI

Dynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there. Our products cover risk assessment, evaluation, runtime guardrails and observability for generative AI and agentic systems. We work with enterprises in regulated industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare and defense.

The Role

Our PMs each own a set of business problems, such as getting AI agents approved for production, reducing the effort legal and compliance teams spend on guardrails, or lowering the cost of running guardrails at scale. Almost every one of these problems depends on evidence: whether an approach works, how well, and at what cost. Product Analysts produce that evidence.

Working with the PM who owns a problem, you take a specific question within it and own the answer. You scope the question, design the experiment or prototype, define how success is measured, run the analysis, and come back with a recommendation the PM can act on. When building is faster than waiting, that includes standing up a quick tool with AI to test an idea. You may support several PMs as priorities shift.

Training and infrastructure code is handled by our engineering and research teams. Your contribution is experimental design, prototyping and analytical rigor.

What You Might Work On

• Guardrail creation and upkeep: design and curate the data used to train and accept custom guardrails, keep labeling consistent as datasets grow, and measure whether updates made from production errors improve performance without regressions.

• Control coverage: benchmark detection against new attack techniques, languages and modalities, and scope what closing each gap would take.

• Evaluation evidence: assess whether synthetic evaluation and red-teaming data is faithful and diverse enough for customers' approvers to trust, and research new ways to evaluate AI applications and agents.

• Cost and performance: compare guardrail and orchestration configurations on accuracy, latency and inference cost.

• Alerting: prototype ways to aggregate and prioritize guardrail alerts, and measure their effect on the workload of security analysts.

• Workflow prototypes: build and test prototypes of new workflows, such as how legal and compliance reviewers contribute to guardrail policies or how customers onboard an application on their own, and measure the time and effort they take.

• Rapid tooling: build small custom tools with AI to validate a hypothesis or unblock the team.

• Benchmarking and reporting: measure performance with standard classification metrics (FNR, FPR, precision, recall) and report what is working and what is not.

Growth Path

You will start on well-scoped questions and move to harder, more ambiguous ones. Over time you will build intuition for SLM training, guardrail orchestration, agent security and how controls fit into a full AI application, along with an understanding of how our customers make approval decisions. This is a track toward a Product Manager or senior technical product role.

Requirements

• A degree with strong quantitative or analytical content. We are especially interested in less common backgrounds, such as physics, information or data theory, and business, alongside solid data analysis experience.

• A clear, demonstrated framework for thinking through problems.

• Good instincts for data, ML concepts, and what makes an experiment or metric trustworthy.

• Python and pandas for working with data.

• Interest in AI security or safety, and in adversarial thinking.

• Attention to detail and clear writing, including the ability to turn results into a recommendation a PM can act on.

Nice to Have

• ML coursework, or coursework or projects in statistics or NLP.

• Reading or working proficiency in Japanese, Chinese or a European language.

• SQL.

• A habit of building small tools or scripts, including with AI assistants, to answer your own questions.

• Exposure to LLMs, AI agen

Your Profile

title: Intern Frontend Engineer

We are a small frontend team building a web platform for ML data annotation. • Implement small UI components and pages in Svelte 5 / TypeScript following the design system

• Add component book entries and write unit/browser tests for new and existing components

• Fix well-scoped bugs in the new platform and in legacy projects

• Integrate simple REST endpoints under guidance

• Participate in code review (receive feedback, and gradually review others' PRs)

• Keep type checks, lint and tests green on your changes

• Improve documentation and conventions where you find gaps

• Learn and apply AI-assisted development responsibly

Qualifications and Skills

• At least 1 year of experience and/or a GitHub profile with pet projects available for the team review

• Solid TypeScript fundamentals

• HTML/CSS knowledge

• Familiarity with at least one modern frontend framework (any - Svelte, React, Vue)

• Good understanding of client-server communication

• Git basics

• Ability to understand technical documentation and follow engineering guidelines

• Good written and spoken English (preferably B1+)

Nice to have

• Solid knowledge of Svelte/SvelteKit and Tailwind

• Experience with unit testing (Vitest/Jest)

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows

We offer multiple benefits that include

• The environment of equal opportunities, transparent and value-based corporate culture, and an individual approach to each team member

• Competitive compensation and perks

• Gig-contract (6 months)

• 21 paid vacation days per year, paid public holidays according to Ukrainian legislation

title: Lead Recruiter | Executive
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is hiring a Lead Recruiter to own Director-level and above hiring across our G&A and business functions. You will lead some of the company’s most critical leadership searches, partnering directly with senior stakeholders to identify and hire leaders who will shape Ramp’s next stage of growth.

You will own searches from initial scoping through close, partnering directly with executives and senior leaders across the business. You will be expected to develop real fluency in each area you support, translate ambiguous business needs into clear hiring strategies, and bring an independent point of view on talent.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally strong at research, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating sensitive and confidential searches, and creating structure without slowing the business down. You should be a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, builds pipelines from scratch, and takes ownership of moving searches forward even when the role, target profile, or process is still taking shape.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own full-cycle recruiting for Director-level and above roles across G&A and business functions, from intake and market mapping through offer and close.

- Develop real fluency in the functions you support and quickly build context when taking on a new area, so you can identify the signals that distinguish exceptional leaders beyond title, company, and tenure.

- Build proactive pipelines through market research, targeted sourcing, referrals, and thoughtful engagement with passive candidates. Independently build momentum on confidential searches where broad outreach or an existing pipeline may not be available.

- Develop assessment approaches that surface a candidate’s leadership effectiveness, functional expertise, and ability to operate at Ramp’s pace and scale.

- Move fluidly across functions, evolving role definitions, and competing priorities while maintaining a consistently high bar for talent, execution, and candidate experience.

- Exercise discretion throughout sensitive searches, managing candidate information and stakeholder communication with sound judgment.

 

WHAT YOU NEED

- 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

- A track record of independently leading complex senior-level searches from initial scoping through accepted offer.

- Ability to advise senior leaders, challenge requirements, and influence hiring decisions through clear communication, market insight, and data.

- Demonstrated ability to build fluency in unfamiliar functions, context-switch across very different searches, and maintain strong judgment as priorities and scope change.

- A high level of ownership and comfort with ambiguity. You can turn an open-ended business need into an actionable search, build a pipeline from scratch, and drive progress without waiting for direction.

- Strong closing skills, including experience navigating competing offers, senior candidates, and sensitive searches.

At Ami Arroyo, Inc. , we believe great recruiting starts with people and is strengthened by precision. We want our website and content to reflect that same care. What You'll Own

• Keep projects moving. Turn agreed deliverables into clear tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, and next steps. Follow up on stalled handoffs and flag blockers early.

• Make the brief usable. Gather page goals, audience, offer, visitor action, approved evidence, and assets. Surface missing information before it creates rework.

• Connect design and development. Coordinate Manus AI design outputs, annotated revisions, developer questions, and approved materials without losing context.

• Prepare decisions for Ami. Bring a concise review packet with the exact version, completed checks, open questions, your recommendation, and approval needed.

• Check the work through launch. Review content and mobile layout, test links and forms using test data, track corrections, confirm approval, and verify the live result.

• Keep improvements organized. Maintain a prioritized website-update backlog and report completed milestones, outstanding issues, and upcoming decisions.

What You'll Bring

• Experience coordinating website or content projects, marketing operations, agency accounts, or creative and technical handoffs.

• Follow-through and organization. Own deadlines, priorities, blockers, handoffs, and version history without repeated reminders.

• Strong professional written and spoken English. Turn scattered input into clear instructions, focused questions, and approval requests.

• Editorial and visual judgment. Spot outdated claims, inconsistent calls to action, and mobile or readability issues.

• Web workflow literacy. Check pages, links, and forms, and describe issues clearly to the developer.

• Dependable remote work habits, independent task management, and agreed overlap for U.S.-team reviews and handoffs.

• Sound judgment with AI-assisted work. Verify facts and approved messaging, protect information, and respect approval boundaries.

Experience That's Helpful
U.S.-team experience, website launches, project trackers, and AI-assisted design tools are helpful. Familiarity with Manus AI is a plus, not required. You don’t need to be a designer, developer, or senior copywriter.
What Success Looks Like

• A landing page and a defined batch of website updates are approved, published, and verified.

• We measure finished work and quality for this role.

If you love bringing people, ideas, and details together to turn good work into something great, we'd love to hear from you. At Ami Arroyo, Inc. , every detail is an opportunity to build trust, and we're excited to meet someone who brings creativity, care, and follow-through to the process.

Become a part of our caring community

The Enterprise AI organization at Humana is a pioneering force, driving AI innovation across our Insurance and CenterWell business segments. By collaborating with world-leading experts, we are at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge AI technologies for improving care quality and experience of millions of consumers. We are actively seeking top talent to develop robust and reusable AI modules and pipelines, ensuring adherence to best practices in accountable AI for effective risk management and measurement. Join us in shaping the future of healthcare through AI excellence.

We are building advanced agentic systems capable of autonomously managing and decomposing complex goals. We are seeking an expert in agent design, planning, and control to develop and evaluate agents that can set, adapt, and execute goals in dynamic, real-world environments. You’ll contribute to the scientific and engineering foundations that make AI agents reliable, interpretable, and robust across long-horizon tasks. Key Responsibilities

• Architect goal setting and goal decomposition mechanisms for autonomous agents operating in uncertain or open-ended environments

• Design and implement dynamic planning systems (e.g., hierarchical planning, curriculum learning, scratchpad/self-refinement loops)

• Collaborate on memory, tool-use, and feedback-loop designs enabling multi-step, self-directed agent behavior

• Develop evaluation frameworks for alignment with human intent, consistency, progress against long-horizon objectives

• Prototype agents that interface with APIs, MCP servers, search engines, databases, or real-world actuators to pursue goals safely and efficiency

• Explore mechanisms to detect and mitigate goal misalignment, looping behavior, or undesirable emergent strategies

• Work across teams to integrate goal alignment with safety, alignment, and operational reliability mechanisms

Technical skills

• Proficiency in SQL, Python, and data analysis/data mining tools.

• Experience with machine learning frameworks like Pytorch, Jax, LangChain, LangGraph or AutoGen

• Experience with high performance, large-scale ML systems

• Experience with language modeling with transformers

• Experience with symbolic planning, causal reasoning, and model-based RL

• Experience with large-scale ETL

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• Master's Degree and 4+ years of experience in research/ML engineering or an applied research scientist position preferably with a focus on developing production-ready AI solutions

• 2+ years of experience leading development of AI/ML systems

Preferred Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field

• Demonstrated experience shipping autonomous, or semi-autonomous agents in production or simulation

• Experience with LLM-based agents with scratchpad/self-reflection or hierarchical task decomposition

• Understanding of autonomy risk mitigation strategies, including off-switch protocols, or bounded rationality

Additional Information

Location/Work Style: Remote US

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

title: Coordenador(a) de Estratégia em Prevenção a Fraudes
description:

Para o time de Estratégia em Prevenção a Fraudes , buscamos uma liderança com histórico em gestão de pessoas e visão estratégica de negócio, que domine análise de dados aplicado a fraudes e saiba transformar isso em decisão de prioridade, regra e processo. Uma pessoa protagonista, hands-on, comprometida e que atue com proximidade ao time.
Sua missão será atuar de forma prática e consultiva no desenho, revisão e otimização contínua de regras de prevenção a fraudes, especialmente em Meios de Pagamento. Seu papel será endereçar diretamente o desafio de redução do nível de chargeback, equilibrando a redução de perdas financeiras à preservação de receita e boa fluidez da operação, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

• Liderar e conduzir diagnósticos contínuos para conter ataques, identificar vulnerabilidades operacionais e propor melhorias diretas e automações nos fluxos que visem reduzir o indicador de chargeback para patamares saudáveis.

• Atuar diretamente com análise crítica, validação e recomendação de regramentos em motores de fraude para produtos de meios de pagamento/cartões, orientando decisões embasadas em massa de dados.

• Definir e implementar estratégias de prevenção de fraudes no onboarding de clientes e em transações financeiras, equilibrando prioridades entre as duas frentes.

• Realizar exploração de dados (SQL, Databricks) para embasar teses e desenhar soluções pragmáticas para os problemas levantados.

• Definir e ser responsável pelos KPIs estratégicos de fraude (taxa de fraude confirmada, chargeback, perda evitada), reportando performance e riscos para a Diretoria e Comitê de Risco.

• Garantir excelente comunicação e articulação com os times de Produtos e Negócios para alinhar impactos de regras e comunicar tradeoffs de decisões de fraude de maneira transparente e colaborativa.

• Avaliar novas tecnologias e fornecedores de soluções antifraude, conduzindo provas de conceito (PoC) e implementações de novas soluções e metodologias.

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias, Matemática, Direito, Contábeis ou correlacionadas.

• Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes (gestão de pessoas) em prevenção a fraudes, com atuação estratégica em análise de dados e implementação de processos antifraude.

• Experiência em instituições financeiras, fintechs ou mercado de pagamentos, com ownership de indicadores de perda financeira e redução de chargeback).

• Experiência na elaboração e implementação de estratégias para detecção de fraudes em transações financeiras e onboarding digital.

• Experiência com ferramentas de detecção e prevenção de fraudes, incluindo a criação e otimização de regras e modelos antifraude, usando output de ferramenta de scoring/motor de regras.

• Habilidade em storytelling com dados, traduzindo dados em insights claros e acionáveis.

• Domínio prático de SQL e Databricks (ou similar) para exploração de dados, diagnóstico de cenários, elaboração de relatórios e dashboards e fundamentação de hipóteses.

• Perfil analítico, pragmático e hands-on, com foco em equilibrar mitigação de riscos, perdas financeiras e boa experiência para o cliente.

Diferenciais

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

As an AI Enablement Engineer in Everpure’s Digital Transformation Group (DTG), you will spearhead the journey from generative AI experimentation to enterprise-scale business impact. You will partner directly with cross-functional teams in Finance, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, and Go-to-Market/Customer Experience to design, integrate, and launch high-impact AI capabilities into everyday operations. Embedded within the Enterprise Architecture team, you will establish emergent architectural standards and ensure all technical solutions align seamlessly with enterprise guidelines.

title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

- Run red and purple team operations emulating advanced threat actors across our networks, data center OT, and applications, extending the offensive program alongside the team's other specialists.

- Pen test the networks behind our GPU clusters, from frontend and backend fabrics to out-of-band management and site connectivity, with a focus on segmentation and tenant isolation.

- Test data center OT, including building management, power monitoring, cooling controls, and the IT/OT boundary, in partnership with site operations so testing never puts a live site at risk.

- Break the customer-facing platform, including the console, public APIs, and identity and access controls, hunting for any path from one tenant to another.

- Assess internal and employee-built applications and the CI/CD pipelines that ship them, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults engineers adopt.

- Partner with security and engineering teams on AI-specific attack scenarios, including agentic systems and other novel AI-enabled risks, and contribute to AI-assisted offensive testing tools and workflows.

- Present findings to technical and executive audiences as clear, actionable risk that shapes the security roadmap.
